name: Cloth of Honorable Melee
body:
School abjuration; Level paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (a piece of clothing cloth worn by the paladin that is emblazoned with his god’s holy symbol), DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 2 rounds/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The cloth of honorable melee decreases chances to hit the paladin with missile attacks, including spells that require ranged attack rolls (such as ray of enfeeblement). The paladin gains a +1 deflection bonus to his AC for every three caster levels. Additionally, the paladin gains a +1 competence bonus to Reflex saving throws for every three caster levels versus spell, spell-like or supernatural ranged attacks.
